channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-research
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: twtData X Trends Archive — via awesome-research
item.description: (Lookup): X (Twitter) trending topics by country and city, with a page for each past day; the largest countries are recorded hourly.

item.title: neovim — via awesome-research
item.description: (Free,Cross-platform,Plugins): Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability.

item.title: markon — via awesome-research
item.description: (Cloud, Local PWA): Minimal distraction-free live Markdown editor.

item.title: citeguard — via awesome-research
item.description: Checks a .bib/.ris bibliography (or a single DOI) for cited papers that have been retracted, corrected, or flagged with an expression of concern, via Crossref and the Retraction Watch records it carries. Python library/CLI, MCP server, and GitHub Action; no API key. pip install citeguard-cli

item.title: ToolStack — via awesome-research
item.description: a free toolbox of 122 browser-based utilities (text, JSON, image, PDF, unit conversion, color) that run entirely client-side, with no signup and no file uploads.

item.title: Scientific Figure — via awesome-research
item.description: AI tool that draws scientific illustrations, graphical abstracts, data plots, and conference posters from a text prompt, sketch, or PDF; exports SVG and PPTX at journal column widths.

item.title: Reference Verifier — via awesome-research
item.description: Checks that every reference in a .bib file or LaTeX paper exists in Crossref, OpenAlex, DBLP, arXiv or PubMed, and flags invented papers and wrong DOIs. Open source (MIT).

item.title: ProfScout — via awesome-research
item.description: Finds professors most likely to reply to research cold emails, ranked by reply-fit. Freemium.

item.title: Oleafly — via awesome-research
item.description: Open-source desktop editor for LaTeX, Typst and Markdown with a built-in LaTeX engine, live PDF preview and Zotero citations. Runs offline on macOS, Windows and Linux.

item.title: Manulyx — via awesome-research
item.description: (Cloud): Online LaTeX editor for writing and revising papers with co-authors: real-time co-editing, track changes, publisher templates, submission stages, response-to-reviewers letters and marked manuscripts. Free plan available.

item.title: JournalCompass — via awesome-research
item.description: Free bilingual journal finder: CAS zones, impact factors, review times, APC/OA status and an AI journal matcher.

item.title: Glasp — via awesome-research
item.description: Web and YouTube highlighter with AI summaries and notes, plus Kindle highlights import. Browser extensions, iOS and Android apps, and an MCP server; export to Notion, Obsidian and Zotero.

item.title: Articlo — via awesome-research
item.description: Prepares existing Word manuscripts for a target journal with an editable document, change summary, and author checklist. Free readiness check; paid manuscript preparation.
